text: Ironvale Athletic's equalizer at 86' showcased the effectiveness of their direct, vertical counter-attacking style. Following a clearance by Redmond Rovers, Jonah Lindqvist's progressive carry and short assist to Ilias Thorne enabled a quick, two-player build-up that exploited the space left behind Redmond's high defensive line, resulting in a goal from close range [#1532] [#1533] [#1534] [#1537]. This moment underlines the risk Redmond takes with their high press and defensive line against a setup specializing in fast counters. The key coaching point is to reinforce coordinated pressing triggers and defensive cover to minimize exploitable gaps behind the back line in the closing stages.
